glosses: To criticise, rebuke, or reprimand (someone), usually in a gentle and kind tone.

examples.text: Reprove not a scorner, lest he hate thee: rebuke a wise man, and he will love thee.

glosses: To deny or reject (as a feeling, behaviour, action, etc.).

examples.text: She ached to be with Affad again – and to reprove the feeling she frowned and bit her lip.
